profile.headline: Software Architect/Developer/AWS Cloud -- over 20 Years in the field
profile.geoLocationName: Queens County, New York, United States
profile.summary:
I've been working in the software business for over 20 years. Throughout my experience I have developed many different desktop and web based applications, mostly on the enterprise level. My goal is to leverage existing Frameworks, even create my own to accomplish business goals, automate processes and cut operation costs.

Specialties: • C#, Node.js, javascript, restful Apis AspNet .Core 2.0+, MVC, SQL, NoSQL, Angular.js 2+, TeamCity, Octopus, Salesforce, DevOps, JIRA, MSBuild, PS, AWS, S3, Cognito, EC2, Docker, Lambda, Route53, Code-Pipeline, Code-Build, Far-Gate, ECS, K8s, EKS, App-Mesh, Okta, Blazor
